item.title: Six Math Essentials
item.description:
📝 Just a brief announcement that I have been working with Quanta Books to publish a short book in popular mathematics entitled “Six Math Essentials“, which will cover six of the fundamental concepts in mathematics — numbers, algebra, geometry, probability, analysis, and dynamics — and how they connect with our real-world intuition, the history of math and science, and to modern practice of mathematics, both in theory and in applications. The scheduled publication date is Oct 27, but it is currently available for preorder. item.title: Black-White Array: fast, ordered and based on with O(log N) memory allocations
item.description:
📝 The Black-White Array (aka BWArr) is a fast, ordered data structure based on arrays with $O(\log N)$ memory allocations. Amortized complexity for series of calls remains $O(\log N)$. Benchmarks Benchmarks in comparison with Google BTree.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/dronnix/bwarr

item.title: Building a (Bad) Local AI Coding Agent Harness from Scratch
item.description:
📝 Core Concepts Demonstrated Agent Loop The agent loop is really just that - a recursive loop that maintains a history of user - agent interaction. The harness detects and executes these commands automatically. The harness sends a POST /api/chat request with the model name, the full conversation history, and stream: true.
🔗 Read more: https://www.appsoftware.com/blog/building-a-bad-local-ai-coding-agent-harness-from-scratch
